title: 第二十三章 属于官方的委托第二十四章 欧斯派恩正式加入
content_zh:
颜铁龙赶马在到了柔柔旅店门口就急忙下了马车，并将马车交给欧斯派恩。
欧斯派恩在羽米莉莉的指导下，将马车停到旅店畜生棚里，而此时的颜铁龙正向琪莉米丝借钱。
“琪莉米丝大婶，请您借我五枚金币，我一定会尽快还给你的。”颜铁龙语气诚恳对旅店柜台的琪莉米丝拜托道。
琪莉米丝听到颜铁龙诚恳的请求抬头看了看颜铁龙，然后低头继续记录自己今天营业状况。
颜铁龙看到琪莉米丝只是抬头，然后不理自己，他就咬了咬牙将自己佩戴的宝剑放到柜台说道：“琪莉米丝大婶，这一把剑叫赤红之风，是我以青风矿石加上铁用特殊血祭方法打造而成，全长110厘米，宽30厘米，厚度从剑柄前到剑尖为06-01厘米，其重量为1328克。
而剑鞘用青铁木打造，重量为1574克，这把剑拥有让佩戴着提升15攻击速度，以及拥有饮血回气的效果《剑划伤对手会吸收对手伤口流出来的鲜血来补充使用者的气力。》，当然它也能做到削铁程度，我曾经用他一次性劈断三把普通铁剑，而这把剑没有出现任何伤口以及划痕。
由于它的剑刃为赤红色，所以它才会被叫做赤红之风。”。
琪莉米丝看到柜台上颜铁龙的佩戴的宝剑，并听到颜铁龙对宝剑的介绍终于露出认真的表情看着颜铁龙问道：“颜铁龙你什么意思？”。
“琪莉米丝大婶，您曾经教导过我做人要讲诚信，没诚信的人，不管他实力以及在高贵身份，今后很难拥有极高的成就。
而今天我在铂斯特罗要塞向二人借了五枚金币，同时我还答应他们今天就还给他们钱，所以我想将这把剑当做抵押品，抵押给您，您只要借我五枚金币，只要我在一个星期没有筹集到五枚金币，这把剑就归您了！”颜铁龙要将自己佩戴的宝剑抵押给琪莉米丝道。
“这是五枚金币算我借给你的，这把剑你也收回去吧，记住将这张签条，签上你的大名。”琪莉米丝拿出小钱袋和欠条放到颜铁龙面前道。
颜铁龙看到眼前的钱袋以及欠条，他十分爽快的在欠条上签上自己大名，然后他拿着这个钱袋快速离开。
琪莉米丝看到颜铁龙拿起钱袋离开，突然喊住他：“颜铁龙等等！”。
“琪莉米丝大婶，您有什么事吗？”颜铁龙听到琪莉米丝的呼喊就停下脚步，转过身体看着柜台那边的琪莉米丝问道。
“刚刚克米迪斯来我这里，他让我转告你，他有事找你，他让你去他的酒馆找他，还有他已经将你们这一次护送的赏金交给了我，你这一份就当你还账了，而欧斯派恩那一份我会亲手交给他。”琪莉米丝告诉颜铁龙克米迪斯有事找他，并告诉他的赏金已经被自己收走了。
“琪莉米丝大婶，谢谢您的告知，刚好我也去绿羽茜酒馆。”颜铁龙听到琪莉米迪已经收走这次任务的赏金，他胸口疼了一下，同时他表情微笑的向琪莉米丝感谢道，然后头也不回的直接出旅店。
当颜铁龙刚出旅店门口就碰到欧斯派恩，颜铁龙直接将先前借的二枚金币还给他，并匆匆忙忙向绿羽茜酒馆走去。
颜铁龙进入绿羽茜酒馆里，看到里面早已人满为患，并热闹非凡，他好不容易找到做服务生的铂鹰旗南，将先前问他借的三枚金币还给他，最后才走向酒馆柜台。
颜铁龙挤进酒馆柜台，对柜台跟其他客人聊天擦杯子的克米迪斯喊道：“老板，给我来一杯麦酒。”。
克米迪斯并没有注意到颜铁龙到来，直接快速摇了一大杯麦酒放到颜铁熊面前说道：“客人你的麦酒！”。

“咦！原来是铁龙啊，你来这里怎么不跟我大招呼呢？”克米迪斯终于注意到颜铁熊问道。
“呵呵，克米迪斯大叔你都这么忙了，我怎么好意思打扰你呢！”颜铁熊呵呵喝了一口麦酒道。
“有什么不好意思的，你这一杯算我了。”克米迪斯微笑道。
“谢了！克米迪斯大叔最近我可是穷的叮当响啊！”颜铁熊听到克米迪斯请自己就高兴道。
“对了，克米迪斯大叔，琪莉米丝大婶说你有事找我，到底是什么事？”颜铁熊想起琪莉米丝说的话就问道。
克米迪斯听到颜铁熊的询问，神情变的认真说道：“铁龙，这一次我有一个特殊任务要委托给你们。”。
content_en:
Yan Tielong hurriedly got off the carriage when he arrived at the door of Rourou Hotel and handed the carriage to Ospine.
Under the guidance of Yu Milili, Ospine parked the carriage in the hotel animal shed, and at this time Yan Tielong was borrowing money from Qilimis.
"Aunt Qilimis, please lend me five gold coins, and I will definitely return them to you as soon as possible." Yan Tielong asked Qilimis at the hotel counter in a sincere tone.
After hearing Yan Tielong's sincere request, Qilimis looked up at Yan Tielong, then lowered her head and continued to record her business status today.
Yan Tielong saw that Qilimis just raised her head and then ignored him. He gritted his teeth and put the sword he was wearing on the counter and said: "Aunt Qilimis, this sword is called Crimson Wind. I made it with Qingfeng ore and iron using a special blood sacrifice method. It is 110 cm long, 30 cm wide, 06-01 cm thick from the hilt to the tip, and weighs 1328 grams.
The scabbard is made of green ironwood and weighs 1574 grams. This sword has the ability to increase the attack speed by 15 and has the effect of drinking blood to restore energy. "When the sword scratches the opponent, it will absorb the blood flowing out of the opponent's wound to replenish the user's energy." 》, of course it can also cut iron. I once used it to break three ordinary iron swords at once, and this sword did not show any wounds or scratches.
Because its blade is crimson, it is called the Crimson Wind. ".
Qilimis saw the sword worn by Yan Tielong on the counter, and after hearing Yan Tielong's introduction to the sword, she finally looked at Yan Tielong with a serious expression and asked: "Yan Tielong, what do you mean?".
"Aunt Qilimis, you once taught me that I should be honest in life. People without integrity, regardless of their strength and noble status, will hardly achieve high achievements in the future.
Today, I borrowed five gold coins from the two of them at Bostro Fortress, and I also promised them to pay them back today, so I want to use this sword as collateral and mortgage it to you. You only need to lend me five gold coins. As long as I don't raise five gold coins in a week, this sword will be yours! "Yan Tielong wanted to mortgage the sword he was wearing to Qilimis.
"This is five gold coins that I will lend to you. You can also take back this sword. Remember to sign this signature with your name." Qilimis took out the small purse and the IOU and placed them in front of Yan Tielong.
Yan Tielong saw the money bag and the IOU in front of him. He happily signed his name on the IOU, and then he quickly left with the money bag.
When Qilimis saw Yan Tielong pick up the money bag and leave, she suddenly called him: "Yan Tielong, wait!".
"Aunt Qilimis, what's the matter with you?" Yan Tielong stopped when he heard Qilimis's call, turned around and looked at Qilimis over the counter and asked.
"Kemidis came to my place just now. He asked me to tell you that he has something to look for you. He asked you to go to his tavern to find him. He has also given me the bounty for your escort this time. You will treat this part as your repayment, and I will personally hand over Ospine's share to him." Kirimis told Yan Tielong that Kemidis had something to find him and told him that the bounty had been taken away by her.
"Aunt Kirimis, thank you for informing me. I happened to be going to Green Feather Akane's Tavern as well." Yan Tielong felt his chest hurt when he heard that Kirimidi had taken away the bounty for this mission. At the same time, he thanked Kirimis with a smile, and then left the hotel without looking back.
When Yan Tielong came out of the hotel door, he met Ospine. Yan Tielong directly returned the two gold coins he had borrowed before and hurriedly walked to Lu Yuqian's Tavern.
Yan Tielong entered Lu Yuqian's tavern and saw that it was already overcrowded and bustling. He finally found Platinum Eagle Qinan, who was the waiter, and returned the three gold coins he had borrowed from him before walking to the tavern counter..
Yan Tielong squeezed into the tavern counter and shouted to Kemedis, who was chatting with other guests at the counter and wiping glasses: "Boss, give me a glass of ale."
Kermitis didn't notice Yan Tielong's arrival, and quickly shook a large glass of ale, put it in front of Yan Tiexiong and said: "Your ale, guest!".
"Hey! It turns out to be Tielong. Why don't you say hello to me when you come here?" Kermidis finally noticed Yan Tiexiong and asked.
"Haha, Uncle Kemedis, you are so busy, how can I bother you?" Yan Tiexiong said, taking a sip of ale.
"No need to be embarrassed, your drink is mine." Kemedis said with a smile.
"Thank you! Uncle Kemedis, I have been very poor recently!" Yan Tiexiong said happily when he heard Kemedis invited him.
"By the way, Uncle Kemedis, Aunt Qilimis said you came to see me for something, what exactly was it about?" Yan Tiexiong asked, remembering what Qilimis had said.
When Kemidis heard Yan Tiexiong's inquiry, his expression became serious and said: "Tielong, this time I have a special task to entrust to you.".
